rule: runtimeImplemented=true never creates productionReady=true by itself.

requirementSemantics.authority: Current versioned authority explicitly permits the Method capability and dispatch scope.
requirementSemantics.runtime: A physical deterministic runtime/adapter exists for the permitted scope.
requirementSemantics.projection: A governed client-safe canonical projection exists and raw Core schema is not the client contract.
requirementSemantics.frontend: A real Production consumer route can request the capability without importing Core runtime code directly.
requirementSemantics.acceptance: Current Production acceptance explicitly covers the capability and its restrictions.
